card.name: The word for after opioid use
card.fires_on: The word "for" right after "using opioids" in the advice to pregnant women about neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome. It is followed by a phrase like "a prolonged period" or "an extended period of time".

modes.label: for after opioids
modes.description: The word "for" after "women using opioids", introducing the length of use.
modes.example: to protocols developed by neonatology experts. Observe newborns for signs of neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome and manage accordingly. Advise pregnant women using opioids<< for>> a prolonged period of the risk of neon

card.writes: It pushes against "used" or "used for" style words (in English and Chinese) and favors other continuations, which suits "for" meaning duration.
card.plain: It fires on the word "for" in the sentence about pregnant women taking opioids for a long time.
